map.📚 深度解析：综合成本率（承保盈亏核心指标）: 📚 Deep Dive: Combined Ratio (Underwriting Core Metric)
map.看承保端是否赚钱：<100% 承保盈利，>100% 承保亏损靠投资收益补。: See if the underwriting side makes money: <100% underwriting profit, >100% underwriting loss covered by investment income.
map.横向对比不同业务线或年份的综合成本率。: Compare combined ratios across lines of business or years.
map.仅承保端赚 10%；还要看投资收益。若投资收益覆盖不了费用超支，整体仍可能亏。: Only a 10% underwriting profit; you must also look at investment income. If investment income cannot cover the expense overrun, the overall result can still be a loss.
map.综合成本率低于 100% 就真盈利吗？: Does a combined ratio below 100% mean real profit?
map.只代表承保端盈利，未含投资收益。保险利润=承保利润+投资收益，低利率环境下即使: It only means underwriting profit, excluding investment income. Insurance profit = underwriting profit + investment income; even at CR=98% in a low-rate environment, investment income can fill the gap or do better.
map.综合成本率：CR = (赔款支出 + 营运费用) ÷ 保费收入 × 100（%）: Combined ratio: CR = (claims + operating expenses) ÷ premium income × 100 (%); underwriting margin = 100 − CR (%). Validation: all three fields are required valid numbers; claims and operating expenses must be ≥ 0 and premium income > 0 (premium is the denominator), otherwise a prompt stops the run and no result, detail table, history entry or export is produced. Rule: CR < 100 means an underwriting profit, ≥ 100 an underwriting loss, and the lower the value the better the underwriting quality. The verdict is shown only for valid inputs: a negative claim once drove CR negative yet was still labelled an underwriting profit with an underwriting margin above 100%.
